l9_verdict.rule: SCALES if MAE(V_max) - MAE(V_min) > across-cell std at V_min; FLAT if every MAE is within one V_min std of MAE(V_min); else MIXED

l2_verdict.rule: ACCUMULATES if the mean rho_bar at rho = 0.0 is monotonically non-decreasing in V and the V_max value exceeds the V_min value by more than the larger of the two stds
